# Support

Thanks for using `posthog-js`. This file points you to the right place depending on what you need.

## Questions and usage help

- Read the [PostHog documentation](https://posthog.com/docs).
- Browse existing [GitHub Discussions and Issues](https://github.com/PostHog/posthog-js/issues) before opening a new one.

## Reporting bugs

- Open a [bug report](https://github.com/PostHog/posthog-js/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) using the issue template.
- Include a minimal reproduction, the SDK version, and the browser / runtime where you saw the issue.

## Requesting features

- Open a [feature request](https://github.com/PostHog/posthog-js/issues/new?template=feature_request.md) using the issue template.

## Contributing changes

- See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for local setup and the CI-aligned checks to run before opening a PR.
